label: description
content: comprehensive brand architecture project that unifies a dual-sector enterprise: AM Decor (construction) and 3M (real estate), intrinsically linked by the shared DNA of their three founding brothers. the core strategy centered on creating a seamless visual system, balancing industrial rigor with corporate sophistication to establish a cohesive ecosystem. this alignment transcends conceptual theory; it is tangibly executed across all touchpoints, from large-scale architectural graphics to integrated digital platforms, creating a unified and authoritative presence for the group.

label: tools
content: adobe illustrator, adobe photoshop, figma, wordpress.com

label: mission
content: to deliver construction works that combine functionality, aesthetics and safety.

label: vision
content: to become a leader in the sector by combining traditional construction solutions with technological advance and environmental sustainability.

label: target
content: clients interested in renovating, building, selling and buying a home.

label: deliverables
content: dual-brand identity system, retail signage, fleet livery, 2 corporate websites
